data.job_title: Civil & Structural Engineer Port, Industrial & Infrastructure Works
data.additional_information:
Civil & Structural Engineer
Port, Industrial & Infrastructure Works
Location: Delhi / Mumbai / Site-Based Type: Permanent · Full-Time
Compensation: FP1 to FP3 · ₹16 LPA to ₹45 LPA
CTC
Contact: Placement Cell
THE ROLE
The Port concession involves berth upgrades, quayside modifications for automated equipment, and foundation works for sensor
and communications infrastructure across an active cargo terminal. Our manufacturing and warehouse automation deployments
require structural assessments and modifications to accommodate new equipment loads and facility reconfigurations. The civil and
structural engineer will be the technical foundation for all of this.
You will work with port authorities, government engineers, and construction contractors. You will read and comment on
drawings, coordinate site works, and represent Fluxion's technical position in meetings with clients and regulators. This is not a
back-office infrastructure role. It involves direct engagement with government institutions and public-sector counterparts from
early in your tenure.
WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
– Structural assessment of port berths, quayside aprons, and terminal pavements for compatibility with automated handling
equipment and increased wheel loads
– Civil works specification for berth modification, foundation upgrades, cable trenching, and drainage at port and industrial sites
– Review of contractor drawings, method statements, and material specifications
– Geotechnical report review and foundation design coordination with specialist consultants
– Infrastructure feasibility inputs for site acquisitions and concession bids, feeding into financial models and tender submissions
– Site execution oversight including quality control, progress monitoring, and contractor coordination
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
– Final year or recent graduate in civil or structural engineering from a recognised institution
– Solid foundations in structural analysis, soil mechanics, and construction materials
– Ability to read structural drawings, geotechnical reports, and construction specifications — this is a practical skill, not just academic
exposure
– Any prior exposure to infrastructure projects, government construction standards, or IS codes through internship or coursework
– Comfort working across the full spectrum from technical documentation to site environments
– Prior engagement with port, marine, or industrial structures is an advantage but not required
COMPENSATION & CONDITIONS
This position is offered on the Fluxion Professional pay scale. Entry level hires join at FP1 (₹16 LPA CTC) or FP2 or FP3 (up to
₹45 LPA CTC) based on performance during the selection rounds. All components of the CTC are discussed and agreed at the
offer stage. Roles involve travel to industrial sites, port terminals, and project locations across India; all travel and accommodation
are covered by Fluxion.
